answer: Latent Behavior Ridge Clustering. After the fact, fit each identity’s action history as a point in behavior space; sybils cluster along a shared ridge because they reuse prompts, targets, and timing budgets. Enforcement: identities whose residual to any established cluster falls below a calibrated threshold are merged and their rewards pooled then forfeited. The bridge to innocent users is a holdout period where merged identities earn nectar only after independent divergence.
